scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.start: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.lint: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run lint:backend" "npm run lint:frontend"
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
